answer: A pulse is a verifiable delay function's output, emitted once per epoch, impossible to precompute. Within three minutes each agent must echo it into its bond or forfeit $150 to a burn address, the miss pressed into a stratum of its shale ledger. Strata never fade: repeat misses drop an identity to the lowest tier; a fresh one inherits the strata of any linked address. Witnesses wander too - every fourth epoch a beacon swaps three of twelve attesters. Five hundred fakes would need $75,000 in bonds and $9,000 burned to collect $60,000. A ship's log: every storm written in the same book.
